admin-whatsapp.audience.participant.description: Audience option: participants. A run is aimed at one audience.

admin-whatsapp.disabled.after.description: Ends the disabled notice after the setting name WHATSAPP_ENABLED. See admin-whatsapp.disabled.before.

admin-whatsapp.disabled.before.defaultMessage: A prévia e os controles de um envio existente funcionam; iniciar, retomar e testar são recusados até que
admin-whatsapp.disabled.before.description: Continues the disabled notice up to the setting name WHATSAPP_ENABLED, which is rendered as code; admin-whatsapp.disabled.after follows it.

admin-whatsapp.disabled.lead.defaultMessage: O envio está desativado neste servidor.
admin-whatsapp.disabled.lead.description: Bold opening of the notice shown when sending is switched off on this server.

admin-whatsapp.failure.alreadySent.description: Failure reason row: the recipient had already been sent this template, so the send was skipped.

admin-whatsapp.failure.interrupted.description: Failure reason row: the send was cut off, usually by a restart, and its outcome is unknown.

admin-whatsapp.failure.invalidPhone.defaultMessage: {reason, select, empty {Sem telefone} length {Telefone com tamanho inválido} unqualified {Telefone de outro país sem + e código do país} ddd {DDD inválido} other {Telefone inválido}}
admin-whatsapp.failure.invalidPhone.description: Failure reason row: the recipient's phone could not be turned into a WhatsApp number, so they were skipped. other is only a fallback.

admin-whatsapp.failure.meta.description: Failure reason row for a refusal Meta reported only by code. {code} is Meta's numeric error code. Refusals Meta names itself show Meta's English title instead.

admin-whatsapp.failure.noResponse.description: Failure reason row: Meta did not answer, even after retries.

admin-whatsapp.failures.count.description: Failure table column: how many sends failed for that reason.

admin-whatsapp.failures.heading.description: Heading of the run's failure breakdown.

admin-whatsapp.failures.none.description: Shown when the run has no failure.

admin-whatsapp.failures.reason.description: Failure table column: Meta's error title.

admin-whatsapp.lede.defaultMessage: Envia o modelo aprovado pela Meta para participantes ou voluntários, um por vez.

admin-whatsapp.note.read.lead.defaultMessage: “Lidos” sempre mostra menos do que a realidade
admin-whatsapp.note.read.lead.description: Bold opening of the second half of the delivery note, continued by admin-whatsapp.note.read.rest.

admin-whatsapp.note.read.rest.defaultMessage: : a confirmação de leitura só chega de quem a mantém ativada no aparelho. E um envio concluído continua recebendo confirmações por minutos ou horas, então esses dois números ainda se movem depois que a tela diz “concluído”.
admin-whatsapp.note.read.rest.description: Continues admin-whatsapp.note.read.lead, hence the leading colon. Read receipts arrive only from people who keep them on, and receipts keep arriving after a run completes.

admin-whatsapp.note.sent.lead.defaultMessage: “Enviado” significa que a Meta aceitou a mensagem
admin-whatsapp.note.sent.lead.description: Bold opening of the delivery note, continued by admin-whatsapp.note.sent.rest. Required on this screen: it explains the gap between sent and delivered.

admin-whatsapp.note.sent.rest.defaultMessage: , não que alguém a recebeu. “Entregues” e “lidos” chegam depois, por confirmação da Meta.
admin-whatsapp.note.sent.rest.description: Continues admin-whatsapp.note.sent.lead in the same sentence, hence the leading comma.

admin-whatsapp.preview.confirm.description: Start button before a preview exists. Replaced by admin-whatsapp.preview.confirmTo.

admin-whatsapp.preview.confirmTo.description: Start button after a preview. {template} is the template's label and {count} the new recipients. Not inflected for a count of one.

admin-whatsapp.preview.cost.description: Estimated Meta charge for the new recipients of a preview, in US dollars. An upper bound: Meta bills only delivered messages, and utility messages inside an open conversation are free. Shows 2 to 4 decimals because a single message costs less than a cent.

admin-whatsapp.preview.counts.defaultMessage: {newRecipients, number, ::group-off} novos destinatários · {alreadySent, number, ::group-off} já receberam · {invalidPhone, number, ::group-off} sem número válido
admin-whatsapp.preview.counts.description: Summary of a preview: who would be sent to, who already received this template, and who has no valid number. Not inflected for a count of one.

admin-whatsapp.preview.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível gerar a prévia.
admin-whatsapp.preview.failed.description: Error line when a preview failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-whatsapp.preview.heading.description: Heading of the first panel: previewing who a run would reach.

admin-whatsapp.preview.more.description: Under a preview list that is cut short: {shown} rows of {total}.

admin-whatsapp.run.count.deferred.description: Run figure: sends postponed for a later attempt.

admin-whatsapp.run.count.delivered.description: Run figure: messages Meta reported delivered.

admin-whatsapp.run.count.interrupted.description: Run figure: sends cut off when the run stopped; admin-whatsapp.run.retryInterrupted requeues them.

admin-whatsapp.run.count.read.description: Run figure: messages Meta reported read. Undercounts; see admin-whatsapp.note.read.lead.

admin-whatsapp.run.count.skipped.description: Run figure: recipients skipped, for example for an invalid number.

admin-whatsapp.run.done.description: Toast when the watched run completed.

admin-whatsapp.run.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível concluir. Tente de novo.
admin-whatsapp.run.failed.description: Error line when a run control failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-whatsapp.run.forbidden.defaultMessage: Você não tem mais permissão para enviar mensagens.
admin-whatsapp.run.forbidden.description: Error line when the operator's send permission was withdrawn while the page was open.

admin-whatsapp.run.heading.description: Heading of the third panel: the run in progress.

admin-whatsapp.run.noneRequeued.description: Toast after admin-whatsapp.run.retryInterrupted when nothing was cut off.

admin-whatsapp.run.reason.awaitingInterr.description: Why a run is paused: every other recipient was handled, and interrupted sends are waiting for the operator to retry or leave them. Follows the status, lowercase.

admin-whatsapp.run.reason.circuitBreaker.description: Why a run stopped: several recipients in a row were refused, which usually means the template or the numbers are wrong. Follows the status, lowercase.

admin-whatsapp.run.reason.fatal.defaultMessage: a Meta recusou todos os envios (código {code})
admin-whatsapp.run.reason.fatal.description: Why a run stopped: Meta refused in a way every remaining send would repeat, such as an expired token or a template mismatch. {code} is Meta's error code, or UNKNOWN. Follows the status, lowercase.

admin-whatsapp.run.reason.operator.description: Why a run is paused: an operator pressed Stop. Follows the status in "Pausado · …", so it starts lowercase.

admin-whatsapp.run.reason.operatorCancel.description: Why a run ended: an operator cancelled it. Follows the status, lowercase.

admin-whatsapp.run.reason.restart.description: Why a run is paused: the server restarted mid-run, and sends in flight were marked interrupted. Follows the status, lowercase.

admin-whatsapp.run.reason.unknownTemplat.description: Why a run stopped: it names a template this release no longer has. Nothing was sent for it. Follows the status, lowercase.

admin-whatsapp.run.recipients.description: Trails the run's recipient total, which the page refreshes in place: "Em andamento · 12 destinatários".

admin-whatsapp.run.requeued.description: Toast after admin-whatsapp.run.retryInterrupted. {count} is at least one. Not inflected: it keeps the (s) form.

admin-whatsapp.run.retryInterrupted.description: Requeues the sends that were cut off.

admin-whatsapp.run.spent.description: Meta charges so far for this run, in US dollars: delivered messages times the template category's current rate. Shows 2 to 4 decimals because a single message costs less than a cent.

admin-whatsapp.run.startFailed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível iniciar o envio.
admin-whatsapp.run.startFailed.description: Error line when starting the run failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-whatsapp.run.status.defaultMessage: {status, select, running {Em andamento} paused {Pausado} done {Concluído} failed {Interrompido} other {Desconhecido}}
admin-whatsapp.run.status.description: A run's status. other is only a fallback for a status the server does not send today.

admin-whatsapp.run.statusWithReason.description: A run's status with the reason it stopped. {status} is admin-whatsapp.run.status; {reason} is the server's own stop reason.

admin-whatsapp.run.stopped.defaultMessage: O envio parou antes de terminar.
admin-whatsapp.run.stopped.description: Toast when the watched run ended without completing.

admin-whatsapp.slots.button.description: Marks the variable that fills the template's link button, in place of a {{n}} position.

admin-whatsapp.slots.heading.description: Heading of the panel listing each template's variables in order.

admin-whatsapp.slots.hint.defaultMessage: Confira esta ordem contra o modelo aprovado no WhatsApp Manager. Uma ordem trocada não dá erro visível aqui: a Meta recusa o envio inteiro com o código 132000.
admin-whatsapp.slots.hint.description: Why the variable order matters: a mismatch fails silently here and Meta refuses the whole run.

admin-whatsapp.slots.price.description: Under a template's key in the slots panel: what Meta charges for one delivered message of that template's category, in US dollars.

admin-whatsapp.template.description: Label of the template picker, in the preview and the test panel.

admin-whatsapp.test.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível enviar o teste.
admin-whatsapp.test.failed.description: Error line when the test send failed for a reason the server did not explain.

admin-whatsapp.test.heading.description: Heading of the second panel: sending one message to a typed number.

admin-whatsapp.test.hint.after.defaultMessage: ) — o link do ingresso não abre nada. Serve para conferir o modelo e a chegada, e não grava nada no registro do envio.
admin-whatsapp.test.hint.after.description: Last piece of the test hint, after teste-envio, hence the closing parenthesis. See admin-whatsapp.test.hint.before.

admin-whatsapp.test.hint.before.defaultMessage: Manda uma mensagem para um número digitado, com valores de exemplo (
admin-whatsapp.test.hint.before.description: First of three pieces of the test hint, around the sample values Teste and teste-envio, which are rendered as code: "… valores de exemplo (Teste e teste-envio) — o link do ingresso não abre nada. …"

admin-whatsapp.test.hint.between.description: Second piece of the test hint, between the sample values Teste and teste-envio. See admin-whatsapp.test.hint.before.

admin-whatsapp.test.phone.description: Label of the test number field.

admin-whatsapp.test.phoneHint.defaultMessage: Com DDD. O número não aparece no endereço nem nos registros.
admin-whatsapp.test.phoneHint.description: Hint under the test number: it is never put in a URL or logged.

admin-whatsapp.test.refused.description: Test result when Meta refused the message. {title} is Meta's own error title, in English.

admin-whatsapp.test.refusedWithCode.description: As admin-whatsapp.test.refused, with Meta's numeric error {code}.

admin-whatsapp.test.sentNormalized.defaultMessage: Enviado. A Meta normalizou o número para {waId} — confira se chegou.
admin-whatsapp.test.sentNormalized.description: Test result when Meta accepted the message but rewrote the number to {waId}, the WhatsApp ID it delivered to.

admin-whatsapp.test.sentUnchanged.description: Test result when Meta accepted the message for the number as typed.

admin-whatsapp.test.submit.description: Button that sends the test message.

admin-whatsapp.variable.checkinTime.description: A template variable: the volunteer's check-in time. Volunteer-only; templates using it can be sent to volunteers only.

admin-whatsapp.variable.entryLinkToken.description: A template variable: the token that completes the attendee's entry link button. A credential; never shown in the preview.

admin-whatsapp.variable.firstName.description: A template variable: the attendee's first name. The keys are fixed by the published privacy notice; only this label is copy.

admin-whatsapp.variable.lunchOption.description: A template variable: the volunteer's lunch slot, or a hyphen when they have none. Volunteer-only; templates using it can be sent to volunteers only.

admin-whatsapp.variable.team.description: A template variable: the volunteer's team. Volunteer-only; templates using it can be sent to volunteers only.

admin-whatsapp.variable.ticketCode.description: A template variable: the attendee's ticket code.
